doNotImportNotes: No basmati or jasmine alias may be attached to generic white rice.
Keep source qualifiers such as cooked, salted, skin, wholegrain and blend ingredients.
Preserve less-than, trace and missing values separately. Ciqual 9125 basmati and 9901 rice vermicelli have fiber <0.5 g, not exact zero; they were not selected as numeric-ready candidates.

Norwegian rice noodles 05.334 have fat 3.1 g and a recipe-calculated provenance; review preparation before treating them as plain boiled rice noodles. USDA 168914 supplies an explicit cooked alternative without that ambiguity.
integrationRequiredBeforeFuturePublicati: Generalize bounded namespaced catalog IDs in backend getCatalogIngredient, FirebaseIngredientCatalogRepository.remoteIdentity and DriftSelectedCatalogIngredientStore.validate; current USDA-only validators reject new provider IDs.
Extend source-aware publication and audit tooling to preserve EU versus US carbohydrate conventions and exact source references.
Review Polish names and true same-food aliases, without adding unsupported variety aliases.
Confirm canonical source choice and protein/carbohydrate mapping for Ciqual records; do not silently apply a universal CoFID conversion.
Run existing import preflight/read-back and version the search release only after explicit data approval.
